```yaml
name: sccache warmup

on:
  schedule:
    # Run at midnight UTC daily
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET: gs://walrus-sccache
  SCCACHE_GCS_RW_MODE: true
  SCCACHE_ERROR_LOG: /tmp/sccache-error.log
  SCCACHE_LOG: info
  RUSTC_WRAPPER: sccache

jobs:
  warmup:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Ubuntu x86_64
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            build_type: debug
            features: "walrus-service/backup"
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            build_type: release
            features: ""
          # Ubuntu ARM64
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            build_type: debug
            features: "walrus-service/backup"
          - os: ubuntu-22.04
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            build_type: release
            features: ""
          # Windows x86_64
          - os: windows-2022
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            build_type: debug
            features: "walrus-service/backup"
          - os: windows-2022
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            build_type: release
            features: ""
          # macOS x86_64
          - os: macos-13
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            build_type: debug
            features: "walrus-service/backup"
          - os: macos-13
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            build_type: release
            features: ""
          # macOS ARM64
          - os: macos-14
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            build_type: debug
            features: "walrus-service/backup"
          - os: macos-14
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            build_type: release
            features: ""

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Install sccache
        uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@v0.0.4
        with:
          version: "v0.7.4"

      - name: Configure sccache for GCS
        run: |
          export SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET="${{ env.SCCACHE_GCS_BUCKET }}"
          export SCCACHE_GCS_RW_MODE="${{ env.SCCACHE_GCS_RW_MODE }}"
          export SCCACHE_ERROR_LOG="${{ env.SCCACHE_ERROR_LOG }}"
          export SCCACHE_LOG="${{ env.SCCACHE_LOG }}"
          export RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache
          
          # Verify sccache is working
          sccache --show-stats

      - name: Build workspace (Debug)
        if: matrix.build_type == 'debug'
        run: |
          sccache --start-server
          cargo build --workspace --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ matrix.features != '' && format('--features "{0}"', matrix.features) || '' }}
          sccache --show-stats

      - name: Build workspace (Release)
        if: matrix.build_type == 'release'
        run: |
          sccache --start-server
          cargo build --release --workspace --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ matrix.features != '' && format('--features "{0}"', matrix.features) || '' }}
          sccache --show-stats

      - name: Post sccache stats
        if: always()
        run: |
          sccache --show-stats
          sccache --stop-server

  notify-failure:
    needs: warmup
    if: failure()
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - name: Dispatch failure event to sui-operations
        uses: peter-evans/repository-dispatch@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.SUI_OPERATIONS_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
          repository: MystenLabs/sui-operations
          event-type: sccache-warmup-failure
          client-payload: |
            {
              "workflow_run_id": "${{ github.run_id }}",
              "workflow_name": "${{ github.workflow }}",
              "repository": "${{ github.repository }}",
              "sha": "${{ github.sha }}",
              "message": "sccache warmup workflow failed"
            }
```
